audit.notes: Very easy to recreate with an existing library. The first half uses calm, everyday or travel clips to accompany the traditional career quotes. After the black screen beat drop, rapid-fire cuts show the creator at their most joyful (smiling, laughing, bouldering, hanging out with friends, city views).
audit.summary: A fast-paced montage contrasting traditional societal career expectations with personal happiness and genuine joy, ending with an invitation to join the community.
